services.desc: Experience the joys of boating in Newport Harbor in an entirely new light with our electric boat rentals at Newport Pontoon and Electric Boats Newport Beach. Embrace the beauty of eco-friendly boating and savor a journey that’s not just about the destination, but also about preserving the pristine nature that surrounds you. Why choose our electric boats in Newport Beach? They offer an immersive boating experience that connects you with nature in an intimate, respectful manner. Feel the gentle ocean breeze, hear the melodic chirping of sea birds, and witness the mesmerizing dance of light on water, all while leaving the smallest possible environmental footprint.
